# Pausen — Android Bedtime App & Scroll Pause App (APK)

> Pausen (formerly developed as SleepGuardian APK / SleepGuardian Mobile) is a quiet, privacy-first Android application and standalone APK for scheduled bedtime curfews, breathing scroll pauses, and warm evening reading mode. 100% on-device, zero ads, zero trackers, no accounts, and zero internet permission.

## Quick Facts
- Application Name: Pausen (Pausen APK)
- Former Project Name: SleepGuardian APK (SleepGuardian Android)
- App Categories: Bedtime App, Scroll Pause App, Screen Time Blocker, Digital Wellbeing
- Latest Release: v1.10.2 (Build Code 8)
- File Name: Pausen-1.10.2.apk (3.7 MB / 3,681,980 bytes)
- Target OS: Android 10 (API 29) and newer (compatible with Android 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15+)
- SHA-256 Checksum: 05d24758639b4f58b31db3fafffef73840f8e5d8c7408d07618b8c3e3a5cf038
- Developer: Approxy-dev (https://github.com/approxy-dev)
- Repository: https://github.com/approxy-dev/Pausen-App
- Download: https://github.com/approxy-dev/Pausen-App/releases/download/v1.10.2/Pausen-1.10.2.apk

## Primary Use Cases & Features
1. **Bedtime App & Curfew Lock:** Schedule gentle wind-down warnings, a warm reading tint, and strict bedtime curfews to enforce sleep discipline.
2. **Scroll Pause App:** Interrupt compulsive doomscrolling in apps like Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube with a 12-second box-breathing pause (4s in, 2s hold, 6s out) and an optional 24-hour commitment lock.
3. **100% On-Device Privacy:** The Android manifest omits the `android.permission.INTERNET` permission completely. All settings, logs, and schedules stay strictly in on-device SQLite storage with zero telemetry, zero analytics, and zero ads.
4. **Anti-Distraction Commitment:** Background protection, clock-change defense, and Settings and uninstall guard support during protected hours.

## Installation Instructions
1. Download `Pausen-1.10.2.apk` directly to your Android device.
2. In Downloads, tap the file. When prompted, enable "Allow from this source" for your browser or file manager.
3. Review Play Protect scans and complete installation.
4. Launch Pausen and follow on-screen setup to grant Accessibility and background access.
